headline: Gasoline in US Hits Its Lowest Level Since Mid-March 2026
summary: Gasoline and diesel prices fell in nearly every US state over the past week, according to GasBuddy's head of oil analysis. Prices are at their lowest since mid-March.
why: Retail fuel prices reflect crude oil costs and refining margins, and they feed into consumer spending and inflation measures.
original_headline: Gasolina en EU se ubica en su menor nivel desde mediados de marzo de 2026
